new_value: KEEP note, not a defect. Verified 2026-09-15 that the practice it flags as worth preserving still holds: hire-core/src/pseudonym.rs derives its known-answer vectors from pyca/cryptography -- an independent HKDF implementation -- with the exact python3 command recorded inline above the tests, so they are reproducible offline by anyone. That property survived today's HIRE rename intact: when the scheme label changed from persona-pseudonym-v1: to hire-pseudonym-v1: the three vectors failed loudly and were recomputed from the same external oracle rather than from this code. The comment format moved from three duplicated commands to one shared template plus per-test salt/info values, which is the same practice more compactly. Closing as recorded; the practice is now also protected by the versioned SCHEME constant.
